description: Maximum supported model and rendering quality for Windows DX12/Vulkan qualification. Apply after each replay checkpoint's environment.
notes: Quality resolves to Ultra, Fixed LOD, Materials + AO, Varied models, Per-model lean, and Smooth 2x. The explicit component values also document that resolved preset.
Smooth 2x falls back to native resolution above the renderer's 10-megapixel supersampled-target budget. Test 1920x1080 as well as 3840x2160.

Connected-globe towns currently render at native resolution regardless of Smooth 2x. Also test AR_SIM3D_GLOBE_UNDERLAY=0 at 1080p to exercise actual supersampling. World navigation keeps projected-size LOD under the Ultra ceiling; neighboring towns in the connected underlay remain Low.
Effect strengths, camera geometry, and gameplay actor range retain their authored values; maximizing these numeric controls does not increase rendering quality.
CRT styling and frame interpolation are separate presentation choices and remain off. Picker easing is not implemented and remains off.
Diorama soft shadow blur is included despite its documented transparent-gap bleed issue.
Live tests animate clouds. Exact capture comparisons freeze cloud drift while retaining clouds and shadows.
The dynamic SIM camera uses wall time. For deterministic SIM-action capture comparisons, additionally set AR_SIM3D_CAMERA_MODE=0; retain the normal camera in live performance runs.
